description.html: The 60x40x90 cm terrarium is a tall vertical model of 216 liters. The base is 60x40 cm, and a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam follows the 90 cm of height. It stands on the floor or on a low cabinet, so that the top stays at eye level. Film of your choice goes on the outside of the sides and back.

For a chameleon, height matters more than floor area: it basks near the top and moves down into the shade when it has warmed up. For a female veiled chameleon or a panther chameleon, 90 cm provides that range. Arboreal snakes need horizontal branches about 50 cm long, at two or three heights. A pair of crested geckos and larger tree frogs use both the background and the branches.

items: Crested geckos kept as a pair

description.html: The 60x50x90 +3D model has a wider base, 60x50 cm. For chameleons you often ask for larger mesh areas for ventilation, so state that when ordering. A custom build takes 7 to 14 days. We shape the background as bark or rock, and you choose the outer film from 34 patterns.
